modmenu.descriptionTranslation.perfecten: Adds the Perfect Enchanting Table: pick any enchantment the item supports, at the level you want, one after another. Searchable list, renaming included, paid with lapis lazuli only - no experience, no randomness.
config.perfectenchanting.title: Perfect Enchanting Table Settings
config.perfectenchanting.ui.remote: You are playing on a server: these settings only apply to your own worlds. The server uses its own config/perfectenchanting.json.
config.perfectenchanting.ui.map_hint: One entry per line: key = value
config.perfectenchanting.ui.invalid: Some values are invalid (shown in red).
config.perfectenchanting.ui.discard.mess: Your changes to the settings have not been saved.
config.perfectenchanting.lapisPerLevel.t: Lapis lazuli per enchantment level. 0 makes enchanting free. Players see changes the next time they open a table.
config.perfectenchanting.scaleCostByRari: Multiplies the cost by the enchantment's rarity (its vanilla anvil cost: 1 common, 2 uncommon, 4 rare, 8 very rare), so Sharpness V costs 5 lapis and Silk Touch 8. Off: every level costs exactly "Lapis per level". Players see changes the next time they open a table.
config.perfectenchanting.renameCost.tool: Lapis lazuli for renaming an item. 0 = free. Players see changes the next time they open a table.
config.perfectenchanting.creativeIgnores: Players in Creative mode pay nothing. Players see changes the next time they open a table.
config.perfectenchanting.allowIncompatib: Allows combinations vanilla forbids, e.g. Sharpness with Smite or Mending with Infinity. Players see changes the next time they open a table.
config.perfectenchanting.allowCurses.too: Shows curses (Curse of Binding, Curse of Vanishing) in the list. Players see changes the next time they open a table.
config.perfectenchanting.disabledEnchant: Enchantment ids the table never offers, e.g. minecraft:mending. Players see changes the next time they open a table.
One enchantment id per line, e.g. minecraft:mending
